page_title: SAS 0-5 INT | Sassuolo v Inter 08/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' That's it for today, Daniele Chiffi has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+1' Inter take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.

90' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. Corner kick. Inter will have an opportunity.
89' 0 - 5 Goal! Luis Henrique (Inter) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top left corner. It's 0:5.
87' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sassuolo.

86' The goalkeeper is not tested by the free kick from the edge of the box by Tarik Muharemovic (Sassuolo) as his effort only hit the wall. The ball goes out for a corner. Sassuolo can continue in their attacking effort.
85' Davide Frattesi (Inter) trips an opposition player and Daniele Chiffi signals a foul. Sassuolo have a free kick.
83' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Sassuolo comes to nothing.
83' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Sassuolo, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
82' Daniele Chiffi shows a yellow card to Federico Dimarco (Inter) for his blatant foul.
81' 38:62 – the ratio of ball possession.
78' Inter seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
76' Cristian Chivu has decided to make a change. Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) replaces Lautaro Martinez.
76' We are about to witness a subsitution. Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) for Marcus Thuram.

75' Petar Sucic (Inter) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
73' Inter take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
71' Here is a change. Andrea Pinamonti is going off and Fabio Grosso gives the last tactical orders to M'Bala Nzola (Sassuolo).
70' Substitution. Andy Diouf (Inter) on for Henrikh Mkhitaryan.
70' That's the end of the game for Josh Doig, who is replaced by Ulisses Garcia (Sassuolo).
69' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) creates space for himself in the box and shoots, but the effort is unwittingly blocked by one of his own teammates.
67' Inter seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
63' Cristian Chivu prepares a substitution. Alessandro Bastoni is replaced by Matteo Darmian (Inter).
63' Substitution. Piotr Zielinski makes way for Davide Frattesi (Inter).

62' Marcus Thuram (Inter) blows a promising chance. He gets to a rebound and unleashes a shot towards the bottom right corner. However, his effort is thwarted by a perfect save from Arijanet Muric, who deflects it onto the post with the tips of his fingers.
59' That will be all from Armand Lauriente who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Luca Lipani (Sassuolo).
59' Fabio Grosso has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Woyo Coulibaly (Sassuolo) replacing Domenico Berardi.
58' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Now Inter have a corner.
58' Inter can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
54' Nemanja Matic (Sassuolo) receives a red card for his reckless behaviour and leaves his team a man down. The manager will have a word with him after the match.
54' The main referee, Daniele Chiffi, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Nemanja Matic (Sassuolo) is given a yellow card for dissent.
54' 0 - 4 Gooal! Federico Dimarco takes over corner duties. Manuel Akanji (Inter) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the middle of the net. 0:4.
54' The referee blows his whistle, Inter are awarded a corner kick.
50' 0 - 3 Lautaro Martinez (Inter) was like a fox in the box, burying the ball into the bottom right corner of the goal. Excellent finish!
49' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) unleashed a rocket of a shot aiming towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
49' Federico Dimarco (Inter) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
48' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
46' Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Jay Idzes (Sassuolo) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
42' The goal by Sassuolo won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
42' Wait! Referee Daniele Chiffi has indicated he is going to review the Sassuolo goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
41' Goal! Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) scores after an assist by Domenico Berardi that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 1:2.
39' Inter failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
38' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) has a sight of goal and shoots goalwards, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save. The ball goes out of play. Inter are awarded a corner kick.
37' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall charges down the ball.
36' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for a foul. Inter win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
35' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Sassuolo, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
33' Federico Dimarco (Inter) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
32' A quickly taken corner by Sassuolo.

28' 0 - 2 Federico Dimarco sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Marcus Thuram (Inter) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot into the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 0:2.
27' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) fires a shot well wide of the right post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.

25' My Gran could have done better! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
24' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Daniele Chiffi has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
21' Great teamplay by Inter as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
18' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes a mid-range free kick and his stunning strike crashes against the crossbar.
17' Inter are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
15' Jay Idzes (Sassuolo) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
15' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Sassuolo, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

14' The ball rebounds off the defender into the path of Federico Dimarco (Inter), who immediately strikes for goal from inside the box but sends it a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
13' Yann Bisseck (Inter) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.

11' 0 - 1 Yann Bisseck (Inter) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Federico Dimarco. His header bounced off the ground and went behind the goalkeeper into the middle of the net. It's 0:1.
10' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Inter.

10' Luis Henrique (Inter) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the middle of the goal. However, Arijanet Muric anticipates the shot and makes a decent save. Good work from Inter as they win a corner.
9' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
6' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
5' The Inter players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
3' The resulting set piece from Sassuolo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
2' The corner is swung in but Sassuolo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

2' What a great touch by Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the right side of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. Sassuolo will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Inter will have the kick-off.
Daniele Chiffi will supervise the game today.
